newsitem.title: USA: Edison now says 1,070 MW unit to start Thurs.
newsitem.headline: Edison now says 1,070 MW unit to start Thurs.

text.p: The 1,070 megawatt (MW) unit 2 at the San Onofre nuclear power plant is still set to restart on Thursday Ray Golden, a spokesman for the company, said on Monday not midnight on Monday as a spokesman for Southern Calfiornia Edison Co said previously.
The unit is expected to enter mode two start-up in the early hours of Tuesday morning, but will not resume power generation until Thursday, Golden said.
It will then take several days to return to full power, he added.
The San Onofre plant is majority owned and operated by Edison, while Enova Corp's San Diego Gas and Electric Co owns 20 percent and the cities of Ananheim and Riverside own five percent.
